_readme: M18-S02-T02 route x role leak matrix. Copy to leak-matrix.config.json (or pass --config). STAGING_URL overrides baseUrl. One restricted sandbox test user holds each role in turn; sign it in once per role with jev-sessions.mjs and point storageState at the saved session (or give cookie directly). scope.ids = every Zoho record id this role may receive (export it from the staging seed); scope.userIds = user ids that may appear (owners, self); scopeKey = the value the server's cache scope must carry, checked only when cacheScopeHeader is set. revealAllowed: true only for a role allowed to see unmasked PAN/Aadhaar/UTR. Never point this at the front-end loop's port 3001.
